name: tron-gas-sponsor
description: TRON TRX gas sponsorship server (master-wallet deposit → fixed GetGas Energy+Bandwidth)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/api & npm run dev --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/config && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/database && npm run link:workspaces && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/api && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/config && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/database && npm run link:workspaces && npm run build --workspace=@tron-gas-sponsor/api
scripts.start:release: npm run db:migrate && npm run start:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run link:workspaces && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
